summary: In an executive office, Agents Jones and Brown burst in on Agent Smith, who has just released Morpheus. Brown demands to know what Smith was doing. Smith recovers and replaces his earpiece. Jones tells Brown, "You don't know." Smith asks, "Know what?" He then listens to his earphone and reacts with disbelief to whatever he is hearing.

what_changes.before: Aware only of the immediate room, asking "Know what?"
what_changes.after: Receiving information through his earphone that shocks him
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith listens to his earphone, not

what_changes.before: Taken by surprise when the others burst in
what_changes.evidence: Agent Smith recovers, replacing his earpiece.

event_hint.one_line: Jones and Brown interrupt Smith's interrogation of Morpheus, and Smith receives startling news over his earphone.

uncertain: What exactly Smith is hearing over the earphone.
Whether the agents' arrival is a rescue of Smith or a reprimand for what he was doing.

minds.wants: To re-establish composure and control after being caught off-guard, and to regain the informational link (earpiece) that defines his situational awareness.
minds.feels: Disoriented and momentarily vulnerable — he was taken by surprise mid-interrogation, and his authority has been implicitly questioned. Underneath, a rising alarm he does not yet have language for, which the earphone will soon give him.
minds.shows: A smooth recovery: releasing Morpheus, replacing the earpiece, and answering Brown with a cool, almost idle "Know what?" — performing unshakable competence.
minds.basis: The stage direction 'Agent Smith recovers, replacing his earpiece' shows him regaining poise after being startled. His question 'Know what?' is calm, deflecting Brown's accusation. He then listens and is visibly shaken, confirming that his composure was a surface over something about to break.

believes_about.belief: That Brown's 'What were you doing?' is an intrusion by a subordinate who doesn't understand the larger situation.
believes_about.wrong_because: Brown may actually be registering that Smith lost control of a prisoner — a legitimate concern Smith would rather dismiss than confront.

believes_about.belief: That Jones's 'You don't know' is an opaque rebuke he can deflect with a question.
believes_about.wrong_because: Jones is about to be proven irrelevant himself; Smith's belief that he can stay one step ahead is exactly what the earphone shatters.

minds.wants: To hold Smith accountable — to get an answer for what Smith was doing alone with the prisoner.
minds.feels: Frustration and suspicion: he has burst in expecting to find a situation under control or going wrong, and instead finds Smith detached, which reads as negligence or something worse.
minds.shows: Direct accusation — 'What were you doing?' — the most emotionally transparent of the three, letting his irritation surface.
minds.basis: Brown opens the scene with a demand rather than a report, and is immediately told 'You don't know,' which positions him as the one out of the loop. His line is the only openly confrontational one here.

believes_about.belief: That Smith was careless or insubordinate in releasing/losing Morpheus, and that Brown is the one who sees the problem clearly.
believes_about.wrong_because: Brown assumes he has the fuller picture; Jones's 'You don't know' signals that Brown is actually the one missing critical information.

minds.wants: To redirect the room's attention from blame to a larger, incoming reality — to make the others stop and register something Brown hasn't perceived.
minds.feels: A controlled urgency; he has information (or has just received it) that reframes the whole situation, and he is watching the others catch up.
minds.shows: Terse, cryptic authority — 'You don't know' — refusing to explain, letting the mystery itself command the room.
minds.basis: Jones does not answer Brown's question but overrides it with 'You don't know,' a move that only makes sense if he is operating from knowledge the others lack. This sets up Smith's own earphone revelation.

believes_about.belief: That Smith, like Brown, is still working from an outdated read of the situation and needs to be corrected.
believes_about.wrong_because: Inferred: Jones assumes he is the most informed person present, but the scene's turn to Smith's earphone suggests Smith is about to receive information that surpasses even Jones's.

minds.wants: Nothing he can act on — he is a released prisoner, physically spent and at the mercy of whatever the Agents decide.
minds.feels: The residue of interrogation and near-death (sc-154: 'face ashen like someone near death'), now a watchful, contained stillness — a man who has already decided he will not give them more.
minds.shows: Nothing outward; he is silent and released, an object of the Agents' conflict rather than a participant.
minds.basis: Morpheus is present but given no dialogue or action in this scene; he was just being interrogated and released. His interior life here is inferred from his established condition in sc-154 and his role as the contested prisoner.

believes_about.belief: That Smith is a captor who believes he still controls the situation.
believes_about.wrong_because: Morpheus cannot yet know the Agents are losing their grip — the earphone revelation and the imminent rescue (ev-028) will prove their control illusory.

connects_back: sc-154: Morpheus's near-death state and Tank's warning that 'they're coming for you' — the interrogation Smith was conducting is now interrupted, and Morpheus is still the prize.

The Government Building Assault (ev-027): Neo and Trinity's violent breach of the building is the incoming threat the Agents are beginning to register, which explains the urgency behind Jones's 'You don't know' and the earphone news.
sc-156: Trinity and Neo arming up and killing guards establishes why the Agents are suddenly receiving alarming information over their link.
sets_up: The Agents' realization that their prisoner is being actively rescued, prompting them to respond to the breach rather than continue the interrogation.
Smith's shock over the earphone priming the Agents to converge on the threat, leading into the armed confrontation of the rescue (ev-028).
The fracture in the Agents' assumed control that will carry through their pursuit onto the roof and into the subway showdown (ev-029–031).
dramatic_function: This scene pivots the Agents from interrogators to the reactive party: it converts the off-screen assault (ev-027) into the Agents' dawning awareness, using Smith's earphone shock to transfer momentum from their control to the rescuers' initiative and to foreshadow their loss of Morpheus.
